scripts.dev: npm run ds:generate && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro dev
scripts.ds:generate: node --import tsx design-system/scripts/build-tokens.ts && node --import tsx design-system/scripts/build-registry.ts && node --import tsx design-system/scripts/build-docs.ts
scripts.check: npm run ds:validate && npm run lint && npm run ds:generate && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro check
scripts.build: npm run ds:generate && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run test:visual
scripts.ci: npm run verify && npm run test:visual-regression && npm run build:production && npm run test:performance && npm run test:routes && npm run test:analytics-events && npm run test:semantic-core && npm run test:review-notes && npm run test:internal-links && npm run test:seo-metadata && npm run ci:baseline
